# Sagar Lad — sagarlad.com

> Practical frameworks on money, career, life and awareness — from author, investor and public speaker Sagar Lad.

Sagar Lad is an author, investor and public speaker based in India. His work focuses on practical frameworks for personal finance, career growth, and self-awareness. He publishes books, blog posts, videos, and a weekly newsletter.

## Key Topics
- Personal finance and money management
- Career growth and professional development
- Self-awareness and productivity
- Public speaking and mentorship
